device.name: POCO F7 / Redmi Turbo 4 Pro
device.boot_header: Android boot image v4, 4 KiB pages, kernel-only boot.img (ramdisk in init_boot.img)

kernel.why: Exact AOSP GKI commit from the stock kernel version string. Building the same source with the extracted stock config keeps vermagic and vendor module ABI compatible.

sukisu.version_note: Pinned to the revision that the reviewed SukiSU+SUSFS compatibility patch applies to cleanly.

kernelsu.version: official KernelSU main (Nov 9 2026; manager 32680 or newer)
kernelsu.version_note: Pinned to the commit that the current SUSFS KernelSU patch is synced with; earlier revisions reject it. KSU_VERSION comes from the git history, so the source is cloned, not downloaded as a tarball.

ksunext.patch: none - KernelSU-Next ships SUSFS as a guard LKM (kernel/susfs), there is no CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS

patches.credit: SUSFS by simonpunk; SukiSU-Ultra by the SukiSU team; KernelSU by tiann; KernelSU-Next by the KernelSU-Next team; SukiSU/SUSFS compatibility patch reviewed by Henry-Hilton (Onyx Wild Performance).
